info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Estimates-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates API provides customers with the ability to access and retrieve billing estimates for utility services. This endpoint offers detailed insights into expected charges based on usage patterns and rate structures. Typical consumers include utility managers, financial analysts, and application developers integrating billing functionalities into their systems. By utilizing this API, users can streamline their budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring better financial planning based on anticipated utility costs.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to request a billing estimate based on specified criteria. It generates an estimate reflecting the potential costs associated with the requested services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve an estimate for a billing operation. Ensure that the request contains all necessary parameters in the specified format as outlined in the schema.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing estimate.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.title: Billing Estimate Response

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the billing estimate.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the billing estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message regarding the operation's outcome.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the billing estimate operation.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for a successful billing estimate operation.
